title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f82r coupled apparatus has two ingredient amounts or two graded states
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. GDT790 fixes the upper f82r coupled two-figure apparatus and its opening line with two bounded X daiin fields. Wellcome MS.542 in GDT735 distinguishes learned drug or part name from hot/dry grade, while GDT755 records historical amount/unit and degree formulae separately. Compare a full-record reading in which the two fields quantify two visible inputs against one in which they grade two states of a single apparatus or participant. The physical owner and both fields are fixed; no independent amount, grade, or participant word is bound. This does not promote daiin to a number or degree. Raw unreviewed, not selected.

design.mechanism: parallel bounded fields scope either two distinct materials or two qualities of one owned system
design.unit: f82r upper coupled apparatus and its complete paragraph
design.contrast: two ingredient amounts versus two graded states of one owner
design.prediction: Two-input reading requires two independently identifiable inputs and matching units; state reading requires one retained participant and opposed or sequential qualities. If image ownership does not separate inputs, the reading remains open.
